topic: Data transfer and frame mapping instructions
summary_markdown: The conversation focused on clarifying data handling for a project. Regarding point 2, the instruction was given to use coordinates already defined in the facility system rather than those from a spreadsheet (sheet). For point 1, it was confirmed that only frames needed to be copied/transferred, and no complex merging of other fields was required.
decisions: Use existing facility coordinates for mapping.
Only transfer frames for point 1; do not merge other data fields.
